title: Upwhirl
summary: UPWHIRL, verb intransitive upwhurl'. [up and whirl.] To rise upwards in a whirl; to whirl upwards. UPWHIRL', verb transitive To raise upwards in a whirling direction.

inlines.v: UPWHIRL, verb intransitive upwhurl'. [up and whirl.] To rise upwards in a whirl; to whirl upwards. UPWHIRL', verb transitive To raise upwards in a whirling direction.
